subject.title: fix(policy): allow PolicyFixMetadata overrides to replace checkId and fixClass

question: Should OpenClaw support custom policy fix-metadata inheritance/overrides, or keep `PolicyFixMetadata` as an internal policy-plugin table?
rationale: The current public plugin health contract already supports custom `HealthFinding.checkId`, while this PR changes a private policy helper and does not establish a documented custom metadata API.

options.title: Keep Metadata Internal
options.body: Reject this helper-export path and keep custom checks on the public health SDK contract unless a concrete API proposal is opened.

options.title: Design A Public Policy API
options.body: Sponsor a documented policy metadata API with package exports, compatibility tests, and real doctor/policy proof before accepting custom fix recommendations.

options.title: Accept A Narrow Internal Override
options.body: Allow internal metadata rows to override IDs/classes after fixing the options type, while still documenting that it is not a plugin API.

recommendation.title: Keep Metadata Internal
recommendation.body: Reject this helper-export path and keep custom checks on the public health SDK contract unless a concrete API proposal is opened.

likelyOwner.reason: This account authored the merged policy metadata foundation that owns the affected table and API boundary.
